documents.note: From MB's generic blog on salary loans (published 27/11/2025), which lists documents in general terms; the product page itself lists no documents. Application is online in the app.

eligibility.notes: Product page conditions: resident Vietnamese individual; has an MB payment account, identified, with signed service-use agreement; no late principal/interest payment at MB, no group-2 debt at MB or other credit institutions in the last 12 months and no bad debt in the last 36 months; at least 6 months of employment from the first salary period; average income over the last 3 months at least 5,000,000 VND/month; meets MB's repayment-source rules. Applies to ordinary customers plus special groups (military, Viettel / Tan Cang Sai Gon staff).

textVi.note: Not stated on the product page. Would be in the loan contract or the fee schedule PDF (not read).

products.notes: Principal repayment: equal instalments monthly, every 3 months or every 6 months (customer chooses); interest paid monthly on actual outstanding balance (suggests reducing balance but the page does not say so, so basis stays unknown). Loan method: per disbursement ('theo món'). The page has a calculator with a 'Dư nợ giảm dần / Dư nợ cố định' switch; its default output is not a published bank example and is not used. Insurance: the page does not mention any, so the empty list does not prove none exists. 'Vay nhanh - Vay theo lương' in the app appears to be a path within this same product family; no separate terms are published, so it is not listed separately.

researchNotes: Licensing: 'mb-bank' exists in data/licensed-institutions.json (Ngân hàng TMCP Quân Đội, NHTM Cổ phần, category bank). Gaps: (1) No interest-rate number is published for unsecured consumer loans; only 'theo quy định của MB từng thời kỳ'. The rate disclosure page https://www.mbbank.com.vn/ho-tro/bieu-lai-suat?tab=lai-suat-cap-tin-dung lists reference rates 8.5-9.5%/year (by term and review frequency) and average personal lending rate 8.94%/year as at 29/10/2026; these are benchmarks, not a product rate. (2) Fee schedules (KHCN services 26/06/2026; cards 22/08/2026; credit-card interest 26/06/2026) are PDFs on webcdn.mbbank.com.vn that return HTTP 403 to non-browser clients; not downloaded, so loan fees, early-repayment fee and late-payment penalty are unknown. (3) No public terms and conditions page for the loan was found. (4) Insurance is not mentioned on official pages. (5) Overdraft (thấu chi): the old overdraft URL now redirects to 'MB Pri Plus' (Priority/Private customers with mortgaged property, up to 5 billion VND, free early repayment), which is secured and outside the MVP target; no mass-market unsecured overdraft page was found. (6) Credit-card installment and credit-card cash loan not researched (lower priority). Contradictions: the MB blog (27/11/2025) says age 20-60 and income from 5 million; a search snippet of an older MB page said 3-5 million and age 22+; the official product page says 5 million and gives no age. A snippet of an MB student-loan article quoted 6.6%/year or 4.8%/year; not verified at the page, not included. Third-party aggregator figures (1.16%/month, 5 million - 1.5 billion, 3-60 months) were not used. Surprising: the product page shows limit and term but no rate, so a user cannot see the cost before applying; the 12-month minimum term and 10 million minimum make it a poor fit for small short loans.
